purpose: Define external catalogue denominators and source lineages before any canonical epigraphic promotion.

benchmarks.public_review_report: more than 230 / nearly 250 texts in the foundational corpus
benchmarks.project_use: historical coverage benchmark and siglum architecture only
benchmarks.rights_boundary: do not reconstruct or redistribute the protected critical edition from reviews

benchmarks.public_repository_report: catalogue of all known inscriptions assembled as basis for lexicon; Middle essentially one major epitaph
benchmarks.project_use: modern catalogue target and source-lineage authority
benchmarks.rights_boundary: systematic structured extraction from copyrighted catalogue remains permission/rights dependent

benchmarks.count_caution: headings include subdivisions, alternatives and a Mysian comparison section; not unique inscription count

benchmarks.project_use: CC-BY-SA dependent machine reference; never independent critical edition

benchmarks.count_caution: not certified exhaustive world total; current 162 UD labels cannot be divided into 536 as an exact coverage fraction before identity reconciliation

period_model.Old_Phrygian: distinct subcorpus using Phrygian alphabet; catalogue sigla commonly geographic (M, W, B, G, C/P/T/NW/Dd/HP etc.)
period_model.Middle_Phrygian: transitional/limited corpus; do not force every ambiguous 4th-2nd c. item into a period without source evidence
period_model.New_Phrygian: Greek-alphabet funerary corpus; traditional numeric catalogue tradition
period_model.Mysian: comparison material in TITUS, not automatically Phrygian corpus evidence

admission_rule: Catalogue existence, TM linkage, or presence in a dependent digital corpus is insufficient for canonical epigraphic admission. Require source-level provenance and reading verification under rights-compatible evidence.
